Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_MutationBaseRate_to: Base amount of virus accumulated in the body every minute. Increasing this dramatically raises survival difficulty.
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_ExpansionRate_toolt: The radius (in tiles) that the viral contamination expands per day.
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_EnableMilestones_to: Enables point distribution and self-purification (Detox) based on survival days.
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_AwakeningPoints_too: Number of Evolution Points (EP) granted when mutation reaches 100%.
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_MaxActiveScripts_to: Maximum number of zombies executing special AI simultaneously. Affects PC performance.
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_DistanceCulling_too: Distance from the player at which complex AI calculations are completely stopped。
Sandbox_KNOX_EVOLVED_DaysToAirstrike_too: Grace period until final purification (airstrike) by the military begins.
